Colonoscopy Report
Date of Service: 11/04/2026
Endoscopist: Synthetic Endoscopist, MD (fictional)
Indication: Screening.
Description of procedure: The colonoscope was inserted into the rectum and advanced to the cecum. The patient tolerated the procedure well.
Findings:
